name: Polaris RZR 1000cc - 2 Seater
blurb: The balanced starting point. Enough power for the big dunes, forgiving enough for a first self-drive.

durations.label: 30 minutes
durations.blurb: The lowest commitment. Enough to learn the controls and cross a few dune faces on the Polaris RZR 2-Seater.

durations.label: 1 hour
durations.blurb: The sweet spot for most riders. Time to settle into the Polaris RZR 2-Seater and get a proper run at the red dunes.

durations.label: 2 hours
durations.blurb: A longer route with more varied terrain and photo stops, for riders already comfortable on the Polaris RZR 2-Seater.

heroPhoto.alt: Two riders in a blue Polaris RZR 1000 two seater on the Lahbab red dunes in Dubai
